target_customer: E-commerce retailers, distributors and brands with large product catalogs
problem: Onboarding and enriching product data by hand takes about 15 minutes per product and hurts search and discovery.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for AI product data enrichment
product_category: E-commerce product data and AI agents

founders.name: Amay Aggarwal
founders.background_notes: Led Catalog AI at Uber Eats, which enriched millions of products.

founders.name: Ray Iyer
education: Stanford BS and MS, computer science
founders.background_notes: Launched the first CPG Ads products at Uber Eats.

technical_complexity.rationale: Extracting and validating attributes from PDFs, images and supplier feeds with LLMs was feasible for experienced ML engineers, with accuracy and provenance as the hard parts.

defensibility.rationale: PIM vendors and LLM tools could add enrichment, so the edge was execution and customer integrations.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: PIM vendors later launched AI agents, and Coveo acquired Anglera in October 2026 after evaluating an internal build.

market_need_then: Catalog data quality limits search and discovery and the founders had seen the problem at Uber Eats scale. Customer evidence beyond company claims was not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident, punchy and contrast driven, for example An army, or Anglera

brand_strength.rationale: A distinctive voice on the site, but searches for the name returned unrelated Angle and Angler brands and there was little brand press.

outcome_analysis: Anglera joined YC in Summer 2024 with founders who ran catalog AI at Uber Eats and pitched agents for product data enrichment. It reached SOC 2 and enterprise positioning and Coveo acquired it in October 2026 to add enrichment to commerce search, with existing customers staying on the Anglera platform. Terms were not disclosed.
notes: Funding not verified: standout.work shows about 500K pre-seed but is a single aggregator with errors, and the Coveo article gives no funding, so no round is recorded. Date of deal 2026-10-29 or 30 across sources. Competitor searches surfaced only 2025 and 2026 launches by Akeneo, Salsify and Syndigo, none dated near July 2024, so the list is empty.
